title.narrative: Air Quality Management Initiative in India

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to enhance EU-India partnership in the area of air quality management, as agreed in July 2020 EU-India summit.

Specific objectives include:

-To improve the implementation of the National Clean Air Programme through the EU know-how, by supporting the regulation and enforcement of Air Quality Management in India.

-To assess the feasibility and added value for EU and India to develop e.g. a finance facility or other means to promote sustainable farming and crop residue management in order to tackle air quality problems related to stubble burning in India.

-To promote better access conditions of European companies, as well as provide opportunities for EU businesses and EU investment in India.
